reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "fix: Allow Azure CLI calls in `flux push artifact --provider azure` on DevOps runners by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5390", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: A bug fix: on Azure DevOps runners, `flux push artifact --provider azure` can now call the Azure CLI. Operators do not need to do anything.
consequence.remediation: None needed. If your CI pipelines on Azure DevOps had a workaround for this, check that it is still needed.

proposed.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` is allowed to call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.
